title: Causal role annotation for one benchmark instance
description: Produced per RUBRIC.md. One file per instance at annotation/labels/<project>-<key>.json.

annotator.description: Who produced this label. 'claude-opus-5' for the model pass, 'author-1' for the human verification pass. Never blank: the paper reports model and human agreement separately.

pass.description: 1 = first model pass. 2 = blind re-annotation for self-consistency (NOT inter-rater reliability).

file_roles.description: Exactly one entry per gold file shown in the packet.

evidence.description: The specific diff hunk, log line or report sentence supporting this role. A label without citable evidence is not auditable and must be 'unclear'.

file.description: May lie outside the gold set; that is the point of the measurement.

rationale.description: Two or three sentences citing concrete evidence.
